question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"captivate"** means to attract and hold the interest and attention of someone; to charm. (मोहित करना)

 
 
• **Example: **Her singing captivated the audience, leaving them in awe.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate word to fill in blank number 4 is **"captivate"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Register **(पंजीकृत करना): To record or enroll formally.

 
 
• **Example:** He **registered** for the marathon last week.
 
 
 
• **Magnify **(बड़ा करना): To make something appear larger than it is, especially with a lens or microscope.
 
 
• **Example: **The microscope** magnified** the tiny organisms.
 
 
 
• **Manipulate** (हेरफेर करना): To handle or control something in a skillful manner, often unfairly.
 
 
• **Example:** He** manipulated** the data to get the desired results.
